title: DeployMessage
$comment: CLOUD -> DATACENTER seam. Published to JetStream stream DEPLOY, subject `deploy.strategy`. Runners subscribe as a queue group (load balancing); a runner acks after successful registration (at-least-once).

deploy_epoch.$comment: RESERVED mechanism for Q1. Monotonic per strategy_id. MVP: always the latest wins, deploy once. Later: a higher epoch replaces the strategy's registered interest without any contract change.

target_pool.description: Optional runner pool / datacenter selector. Absent = default pool.
